name: Church Pages
shortDescription: A Khoo Systems church-website initiative offering mobile-friendly, editable church sites with contribution-based hosting, calendars, contact forms and higher-tier sermon publishing.
suitableContexts: UK churches seeking an editable church website with low-cost or discretionary-discount hosting
Churches publishing events, news, enquiry forms and sermons
Churches that want UK phone support or more maintenance help at higher tiers

pricing.summary: Published pricing lists Gifted Hosting at a normal £10/month rate with a discretionary discount to free, Advanced Hosting at a suggested £7.50/month contribution (£90/year) and Extensive Hosting at a suggested £22.50/month (£270/year); all prices exclude VAT and are subject to the initiative’s discretionary discounts. Confirm current eligibility, final pricing, setup, payment and contract terms directly.

startingPrice.qualifier: Gifted Hosting may receive a discretionary discount to free

tiers.label: Gifted Hosting
tiers.detail: Up to 15 pages, online support and two admin users are listed.

tiers.label: Advanced Hosting
tiers.detail: Up to 30 pages, UK phone support, events and sermon upload are listed.

tiers.label: Extensive Hosting
tiers.detail: Unlimited pages and users plus extensive maintenance support are listed.

gdprInformation: Church Pages links to a privacy policy and states that its newsletter details are not sold or shared with third parties, but the reviewed material does not establish current product-specific hosting locations, DPA, sub-processors, retention or controller/processor roles for customer websites, forms and member areas. Obtain the current Khooseller terms and relevant data-processing terms before publishing or collecting sensitive information.

Sermon audio uploads on higher tiers

Extensive tier lists extensive maintenance support

operator.value: Church Pages states that it is part of Khoo Systems Limited and is powered by the Khooseller website platform.

pricing.value: Published tier information gives normal or suggested hosting charges, discretionary discounts, VAT treatment, page/user limits and support levels.

features.value: Supplier documents editable administration, events, sermon hosting, members areas, Outlook/iCal calendar feeds and YouTube video pages.

support.value: Supplier lists email documentation, higher-tier UK phone support and an available backend demonstration.

editorial.assessment: Church Pages is a UK church-website and publishing service with an unusually flexible, contribution-based hosting model. It is relevant for churches that need an editable public site, events and media publishing without assuming a standard commercial price is affordable. The discretionary model means a church should get an explicit written offer and current terms, particularly for any forms, members content, domain management and externally hosted media.
bestFor: Churches for which website cost is a material constraint
Teams publishing public events, news and audio sermons
Churches wanting a supplier-supported site with Outlook/iCal calendar feed options
strengths: Editable public website, events, forms and media workflow
UK phone support on a defined tier
limitations: Not a church-management database, safeguarding casework system, accounting package or online-giving processor
Final charges depend on discretionary discounts and require a written offer
Product-specific DPA, hosting location, sub-processors, retention and content-export details are not established in the reviewed material
Members-area and contact-form use require careful local data-protection decisions

procurementVerdict.problem: Creating a supported church website when standard subscription costs are a barrier
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A church-focused UK site platform with discretionary hosting discounts and higher-tier event, sermon and maintenance support
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Request the current written tier offer and Khooseller terms, then test real event, calendar, contact-form and sermon workflows while confirming data handling, exports, domain ownership and support response arrangements
